summary: Keep inline images renderable when oversized assistant messages carry metadata

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: An inline image keeps its pixel continuation when its assistant message is previewed. Clipped image metadata carries a separate JSON continuation inside the metadata object; unchanged metadata does not add one. Metadata no longer replaces the image's pixel reference.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or startup work is added.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: No graph recovery or repair is required.
